scope: Broad primary-source survey across major EO methods and applications; not an exhaustive field-wide ranking or a list of installed adapters.

methods.name: TESSERA v2 students
methods.target_and_units: Pixel embeddings; downstream labels or physical variables require a trained and validated head
methods.input_contract: Time-ordered Sentinel-2 bands in the documented non-wavelength order, cloud masks and day-of-year; optional ascending/descending Sentinel-1 series
methods.code_license: MIT
methods.license_note: Repository MIT; the inspected Medium checkpoint card is CC0-1.0. Separate source-data terms still apply.
methods.hardware: CPU or small GPU candidate; not benchmarked here
methods.evaluation_gate: Geographic/temporal holdouts, phenology and missing-modality tests; compare frozen features with simple spectral/time-series baselines
methods.notes: Author inference documentation lists 1.07M/7.11M/21.03M/43.83M student parameters and 4/28/84/175 MB checkpoints. These are author sizes, not local RAM/VRAM measurements. The 2B teacher is not the consumer default.

methods.name: Galileo
methods.target_and_units: Global/local embeddings for classification, segmentation and regression
methods.input_contract: Declared optical/SAR/static/meteorological modalities, temporal masks, coordinates and model-specific normalization
methods.code_license: MIT
methods.license_note: Repository metadata is not a checkpoint or dataset license. Verify all applicable terms before integration.
methods.hardware: CPU or small GPU candidate; not benchmarked here
methods.evaluation_gate: Spatially separated linear-probe and fine-tuning tests, sensor/domain shifts, missing inputs and peak memory
methods.notes: Nano, small and base checkpoint files are listed by the model API; embeddings alone do not estimate carbon or soil properties.

methods.name: Presto
methods.target_and_units: Time-series features and crop/land-use predictions; trained target required
methods.input_contract: Correct band order, actual timestamps, location, missing-band masks and declared auxiliary data
methods.code_license: MIT
methods.license_note: Repository metadata is not a checkpoint or dataset license. Verify all applicable terms before integration.
methods.hardware: CPU or small GPU candidate; not benchmarked here
methods.evaluation_gate: CropHarvest plus independent field/season holdouts; compare with a small tree model and retain sparse-observation coverage
methods.notes: Lightweight temporal candidate. Exact training preprocessing must be inspected before an adapter accepts RSLIB's six-band stack.

methods.name: TerraMind 1.0
methods.target_and_units: Dense features, downstream maps and generative modalities
methods.input_contract: Model-specific optical/SAR/DEM inputs, separate tokenizers and normalization; generative outputs retain model-derived provenance
methods.code_license: Apache-2.0
methods.license_note: Repository metadata is not a checkpoint or dataset license. Verify all applicable terms before integration.
methods.hardware: CPU or small GPU candidate; not benchmarked here
methods.evaluation_gate: PANGAEA/Geo-Bench tasks, missing-modality robustness and generative observed-pixel/radiometry checks
methods.notes: Tiny checkpoint is verified; use a frozen or small-head baseline before optional generative inference.

methods.name: Prithvi-EO 2.0
methods.target_and_units: Task-adapted crop, flood and burn mapping; representations are dimensionless
methods.input_contract: HLS-compatible reflectance/band order, temporal/location embeddings and task-head preprocessing
methods.code_license: MIT
methods.license_note: Inspected code repository metadata MIT; this 300M-TL checkpoint card Apache-2.0. Preserve the distinction.
methods.hardware: GPU candidate; 300M checkpoint and activation memory not benchmarked here
methods.evaluation_gate: Reproduce the task-head benchmark; compare against small models with the same regions, dates and labels

methods.name: AnySat

methods.license_note: Repository metadata is not a checkpoint or dataset license. Verify all applicable terms before integration.

methods.evaluation_gate: Cross-sensor/resolution holdouts and patch-count resource curves
